---
title: "juscraper"
---

Scraper for Brazilian courts and other systems of the Brazilian judiciary.

## Installation

### From PyPI (recommended)

```bash
pip install juscraper
```

### With uv

```bash
uv add juscraper
```

### Development version

To install the latest version from the repository:

```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/jtrecenti/juscraper.git
```

## Usage

```python
import juscraper as jus

tjsp = jus.scraper('tjsp')
dados_cjpg = tjsp.cjpg('league of legends', paginas=range(1, 4))

dados_cjpg.head(3)
```

The package covers the basic needs of querying case data in a set of courts.

Most courts implement some of the methods below; the tables in the Implementations section show which ones each court and aggregator has (the STF, for example, has `listar_decisoes` and `contar_decisoes` instead):

- `.cpopg()`: first-instance case lookup
- `.cposg()`: second-instance case lookup
- `.cjsg()`: second-instance case law search
- `.cjpg()`: first-instance decision search

`.cpopg()` and `.cposg()` take a case number in the CNJ format (NNNNNNN-DD.AAAA.J.TT.OOOO), with or without separators, and return a `dict` of tables with the case elements (basic data, parties, docket entries and other court-specific tables).

`.cjsg()` takes case law search parameters (which vary by court) and returns a table with the results. Many courts limit pagination on broad searches (searches that return many results). In those cases the method warns the user with the total number of results and asks for confirmation before downloading all of them.

| PDPJ        | cpopg, contar, documentos, download_documents, existe, movimentos, partes, pesquisa |

<!-- tabela-cobertura:fim -->

> ⚠️ **TJAP — `cjsg` unavailable:** since ~2026 the TJAP jurisprudence search (Tucujuris platform) requires a [Cloudflare Turnstile](https://www.cloudflare.com/products/turnstile/) CAPTCHA, validated server-side. Because the scraper issues plain HTTP requests (no browser), it cannot produce the token and the backend replies `"A verificação de segurança falhou"`. In that case `cjsg` raises `TJAPSecurityCheckError` with an explanation instead of silently returning empty. There is no workaround through the public API. See [issue #279](https://github.com/jtrecenti/juscraper/issues/279).

Falcao covers national labor jurisprudence (TST and TRTs).

### Evidências e limitações

#### STF: `listar_decisoes`

Retornou 5 registros; colunas exigidas e preenchimento mínimo conferidos no cenário informado.

Ambiente/cenário: Linux local, Wi-Fi sem VPN ativa; jus.scraper('stf').listar_decisoes(pesquisa='pejotização', classe='Rcl', paginas=1, tamanho_pagina=5). Somente a primeira página, sem validação de paginação adicional ou de outros filtros. Versão ou commit testado: 0.4.0; código 91799582d901756b414e7e7eabe774fd3c635ec4.

[Evidência 1](https://github.com/jtrecenti/juscraper/blob/18d506ed586599844a64c81081dcdb73d31112f4/docs/status/2026-10-03.json#L362)

#### TJGO: `cjsg`

A busca devolveu DataFrame vazio, e a resposta HTTP 200 contém o formulário de pesquisa sem resultados. O formulário carrega um widget Cloudflare Turnstile que preenche o campo g-recaptcha-response antes da busca, e a página menciona validação desse token no servidor; o raspador envia o campo vazio. A exigência do token é a causa provável do retorno vazio, também observado nas duas buscas de 03/10. Não foi testada busca com token válido.

Ambiente/cenário: Linux local, Wi-Fi sem VPN ativa; jus.scraper('tjgo').cjsg(pesquisa='direito', paginas=1). Somente a primeira página, sem validação de paginação adicional ou de outros filtros. Versão ou commit testado: 0.4.0; código ea68b715d35bc45b07612911c1348a13d6e1fb3b.

[Evidência 1](https://github.com/jtrecenti/juscraper/blob/6892e5f2417ecc945648c99b05d0bd8bb79d976c/docs/status/2026-10-14.json#L193)

#### TRF3: `cpopg`

As duas consultas, às 12:31 e 12:34 UTC, receberam HTTP 403 do bot manager Akamai e levantaram BotChallengeBlockedError antes do formulário. O mesmo IP vinha fazendo dezenas de requisições ao TRF3 desde 11:28 UTC, e às 11:30 UTC o cpopg do portal JSF trouxe um processo completo, com HTTP 200 e sem bloqueio. O 403 indica bloqueio por uso intenso do IP, não indisponibilidade do endpoint. Em 03/10 o mesmo CNJ recebeu HTTP 200 e retornou só id_cnj; esta reamostra não chegou ao formulário e não esclarece aquele resultado.

#### JusBR and PDPJ authentication

JusBR and PDPJ share the same JWT from the PJe SSO. With the `govbr` extra (`pip install 'juscraper[govbr]'`), `auth_govbr()` opens the locally installed Google Chrome, Chromium or Microsoft Edge, with a temporary profile, on the PDPJ services portal; the user logs in through gov.br, the token is captured and the window closes on its own. If no browser is found, pass its executable to `auth_govbr(navegador=...)`. The token is cached in `~/.config/juscraper/pdpj_token.json` (or under `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/juscraper/`), readable only by its owner, and later JusBR and PDPJ instances load it without a new login. When the portal issues a refresh token, the access token is renewed automatically before it expires. The login needs a windowed browser, so it does not run on Google Colab or CI; there, pass the token to `auth(token)` or set the `PDPJ_JWT` environment variable (JusBR also accepts `JUSBR_JWT`).

### Example notebooks

::: {.callout-warning}
## Notebook runtime and Google Colab

These notebooks send live requests to external services and are not guaranteed to work on Google Colab. Courts may block or throttle shared cloud and datacenter IP addresses even when the same request works from a local connection. Some examples also require CAPTCHA handling, access tokens, or optional dependencies. Local Jupyter execution is the project's reference environment; a connection failure on Colab does not, by itself, indicate a `juscraper` regression.
:::

## Additional information

### What sets `juscraper` apart

- Control over raw files: the package provides an interface to download and store the raw files (HTML and JSON, for example) of each case. By default, raw files are discarded once the data is parsed, except for files that failed to parse.

### Limitations

Because the package is complex and niche, its scope is restricted to keep it simple to use.

- The package does not parallelize requests; users who want parallel requests must build that themselves.
- The package does not cover every feature the courts offer. Users who need other courts must write the scrapers.
